test_title: SSC GD Constable 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Feb, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who among the following was the founder of Bahishkrit Hitkarini Sabha (Society for Welfare of the Ostracized)?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Dr. BR Ambedkar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dr. BR Ambedkar** was the founder of the **Bahishkrit Hitkarini Sabha**, established in the year **1924**.
 
• The main aim of the Sabha was to promote the **welfare and upliftment of the ostracized sections** of society, particularly the **Dalits**.
 
• The Sabha worked to **spread education** and awareness among the oppressed classes and to provide them with **equal rights**.
 
• It was one of the key organizations formed by Dr. Ambedkar to fight against **social discrimination** and advocate for the **abolition of untouchability**.
 
• Dr. Ambedkar, a prominent social reformer and the architect of the **Indian Constitution**, dedicated his life to the cause of achieving **social justice** for marginalized communities.
 
• He believed that education was the most powerful tool for empowerment and worked relentlessly to bring **educational and social reforms** through initiatives like the Bahishkrit Hitkarini Sabha.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Dr. Rajendra Prasad**__

 __
 
• **Dr. Rajendra Prasad** was the first **President of India**.
 
• He was a prominent leader in the **Indian independence movement** and a key figure in the formation of the Indian Constitution.
 
• He was associated with the **Indian National Congress** and played a major role in the **freedom struggle**.
 
• While he made significant contributions to the nation, he was not connected with the establishment of the **Bahishkrit Hitkarini Sabha**.
 
 
 
• **Rabindranath Tagore**__
 __
 
• **Rabindranath Tagore** was a renowned poet, philosopher, and the first non-European to win the **Nobel Prize in Literature** in **1913**.
 
• He is best known for his literary works, including **Gitanjali**, and for composing the national anthems of **India** and **Bangladesh**.
 
• Though Tagore was a social reformer, he was not involved in the formation of the **Bahishkrit Hitkarini Sabha**.
 
 
 
• **Atmaram Pandurang**__
 
 
• **Atmaram Pandurang** was a social reformer and one of the founders of the **Prarthana Samaj** in **1867**.
 
• The Prarthana Samaj was aimed at promoting **religious and social reforms** within Hindu society.
 
• While his contributions to social reform are noteworthy, he was not associated with the establishment of the **Bahishkrit Hitkarini Sabha**.
